TASK. In factory/stations/fix_plan.py, `build_evidence` passes `protected_candidates=_diagnosis_claim_ids(ticket_payload)` to `_bound_evidence`. A ticket with no diagnosis rows therefore protects no candidates, and when the packet is over EVIDENCE_LIMIT_CHARS the cut removes candidates in reverse-sorted order, which can drop the very claim the failing turns offered. Real failure: tests/test_factory_claim_edit.py::test_evidence_menu_and_candidate_matcher_context_are_bounded raises KeyError for the offered claim 'k_sl_1a_k_r1' because it sorts last and is cut first.
Change: protect, in addition to the diagnosis claim ids, every claim id that appears in a failing turn's `candidates_offered` or equals its `matched_candidate` (string values only; use the turns you already built for the evidence, so the set matches what the planner sees). Protected candidates are never cut; if the packet is still over the limit after the other cuts, the existing loops already stop, so do not add new cuts. Add one test in tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py: a ticket with no diagnosis whose failing turn offers the claim that sorts LAST among the scene candidates, and a limit small enough to force candidate cuts (call build_evidence after monkeypatching fix_plan.EVIDENCE_LIMIT_CHARS, or call _bound_evidence directly with the same protected set); assert that claim is still in evidence['candidates'] and that evidence['truncated']['candidates'] shows some other candidates were cut. Do NOT edit tests/test_factory_claim_edit.py; it must pass unchanged. Change nothing else.

WORK=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-24
mkdir -p "$WORK/out"
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
git add -A -- factory tests
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -vE '^(factory/stations/fix_plan\.py|tests/test_factory_fix_plan\.py)$' || true)

start=$(date +%s)
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py tests/test_factory_claim_edit.py tests/test_factory_planner.py tests/test_factory_qualification_run_case.py
took=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))

[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff check $PYFILES
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check $PYFILES
